name: LDR Light-Dependent Resistor
description: Photoresistor forming a voltage divider with a fixed resistor. Analog output proportional to ambient light level. Simple ambient light sensing for day/night detection and energy optimization.
firmwareHint: Voltage divider: Vout = VCC * fixedR / (LDR_R + fixedR). LDR resistance decreases with light. light% = adc / 4095 * 100 (or invert depending on divider orientation).
